definition_en: A departure from what is normal or expected.
example_en: The warm January was an aberration, not a new pattern.
example_uz: Iliq yanvar yangi tendensiya emas, g'ayrioddiy holat edi.

definition_en: To accept something reluctantly without protesting.
example_en: Rather than argue further, she acquiesced to the committee's terms.
example_uz: Ko'proq tortishish o'rniga u qo'mita shartlariga indamay rozi bo'ldi.

definition_en: To warn or scold someone firmly but not harshly.
example_en: The coach admonished the players for arriving late.
example_uz: Murabbiy o'yinchilarga kech kelgani uchun tanbeh berdi.

definition_en: Easy to talk to and friendly.
example_en: Their affable host made the awkward evening easier.
example_uz: Ularning xushmuomala mezboni noqulay kechani osonlashtirdi.

definition_en: Brisk and cheerful willingness to do something.
example_en: He accepted the invitation with surprising alacrity.
example_uz: U taklifni kutilmagan shijoat bilan qabul qildi.

definition_en: Something placed in the wrong historical period.
example_en: The wristwatch in the Roman scene is an obvious anachronism.
example_uz: Rim sahnasidagi qo'l soati aniq zamonga mos kelmaydi.

definition_en: A strong feeling of dislike.
example_en: Her antipathy towards crowds kept her away from the festival.
example_uz: Uning olomonga bo'lgan yoqtirmasligi festivaldan uzoq tutdi.

definition_en: To calm someone by giving them what they want.
example_en: A small refund appeased the angry customer.
example_uz: Kichik qaytarma jahli chiqqan mijozni tinchlantirdi.

definition_en: Severely simple, or strict and without comfort.
example_en: The monastery's austere rooms held nothing but a bed.
example_uz: Monastirning qattiq sodda xonalarida karavotdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi.

definition_en: To give a false impression of something.
example_en: His calm voice belied how anxious he actually was.
example_uz: Uning xotirjam ovozi aslida qanchalik xavotirda ekanini yashirardi.

definition_en: Shortness of speech or writing.
example_en: The essay's brevity was its strength, not a weakness.
example_uz: Insho qisqaligi uning kuchi edi, zaifligi emas.

definition_en: Honest and direct speech, even when uncomfortable.
example_en: She answered with a candor the panel did not expect.
example_uz: U hay'at kutmagan samimiylik bilan javob berdi.

definition_en: Changing suddenly and without good reason.
example_en: The capricious weather ruined three days of filming.
example_uz: O'zgaruvchan ob-havo uch kunlik suratga olishni buzdi.

definition_en: Bitterly sarcastic; also, able to burn by chemical action.
example_en: His caustic review offended the whole cast.
example_uz: Uning achchiq taqrizi butun aktyorlar guruhini xafa qildi.

definition_en: Kept secret because it would not be approved.
example_en: The group held clandestine meetings in a back room.
example_uz: Guruh orqa xonada yashirin uchrashuvlar o'tkazardi.

definition_en: Clear and convincing enough to persuade.
example_en: She made a cogent case for delaying the launch.
example_uz: U ishga tushirishni kechiktirish uchun ishonarli dalil keltirdi.

definition_en: To accept or overlook behaviour that is wrong.
example_en: The school will not condone cheating of any kind.
example_uz: Maktab hech qanday ko'chirmachilikka ko'z yummaydi.

definition_en: An opinion formed without firm evidence.
example_en: Until the results arrive, the cause is pure conjecture.
example_uz: Natijalar kelmaguncha, sabab sof taxmin bo'lib qoladi.

definition_en: Present in large quantity.
example_en: She took copious notes throughout the lecture.
example_uz: U ma'ruza davomida mo'l-ko'l qaydlar oldi.

definition_en: Done quickly and without attention to detail.
example_en: A cursory glance at the contract missed the penalty clause.
example_uz: Shartnomaga yuzaki nazar jarima bandini o'tkazib yubordi.

definition_en: A serious lack of something.
example_en: There is a dearth of reliable data on the region.
example_uz: Mintaqa bo'yicha ishonchli ma'lumotlar tanqisligi bor.

definition_en: Respectful acceptance of another's authority or wishes.
example_en: Out of deference to the elders, he spoke last.
example_uz: Kattalarga hurmat yuzasidan u oxirgi bo'lib gapirdi.

definition_en: To laugh at someone or something with contempt.
example_en: Critics derided the plan as hopelessly naive.
example_uz: Tanqidchilar rejani umidsiz sodda deb masxara qilishdi.

definition_en: Intended to teach, sometimes too obviously so.
example_en: The novel turns didactic in its final chapter.
example_uz: Roman oxirgi bobida pand-nasihatli tus oladi.

definition_en: The feeling that something is unworthy of respect.
example_en: He looked at the offer with open disdain.
example_uz: U taklifga ochiq mensimaslik bilan qaradi.

definition_en: To speak of someone or something as unimportant.
example_en: It is easy to disparage work you have never attempted.
example_uz: Hech qachon urinib ko'rmagan ishni kamsitish oson.

definition_en: Asserting opinions as if they were certain facts.
example_en: His dogmatic tone left no room for discussion.
example_uz: Uning qat'iy ohangi muhokamaga joy qoldirmadi.

definition_en: Speaking or writing in a fluent and persuasive way.
example_en: Her eloquent closing argument swayed the jury.
example_uz: Uning ravon yakuniy nutqi hakamlar hay'atini o'ziga og'dirdi.

definition_en: Willing to take bold risks, sometimes recklessly so.
example_en: The startup made an audacious bid for the market leader.
example_uz: Startap bozor yetakchisiga dadil taklif berdi.

definition_en: A person or thing that is difficult to understand.
example_en: The artist remained an enigma to her closest friends.
example_uz: Rassom eng yaqin do'stlari uchun ham jumboq bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: Careful with money and resources.
example_en: Their frugal habits let them save on a modest income.
example_uz: Ularning tejamkor odatlari kamtarona daromadda jamg'arishga imkon berdi.

definition_en: Done quietly so as not to be noticed.
example_en: He cast a furtive glance at the answer sheet.
example_uz: U javoblar varag'iga yashirincha nazar tashladi.

definition_en: Enjoying the company of other people.
example_en: A gregarious student, he knew half the campus by October.
example_uz: Kirishimli talaba bo'lgani uchun u oktyabrga borib kampusning yarmini tanirdi.

definition_en: Bitter and angry in tone, especially in a dispute.
example_en: The merger talks ended in an acrimonious dispute over pay.
example_uz: Qo'shilish muzokaralari maosh yuzasidan achchiq nizo bilan yakunlandi.

definition_en: Harmless and unlikely to offend.
example_en: What seemed an innocuous remark started the argument.
example_uz: Zararsiz ko'ringan izoh bahsni boshlab yubordi.

definition_en: Using very few words.
example_en: His laconic reply told us nothing at all.
example_uz: Uning lo'nda javobi bizga hech narsa aytmadi.

definition_en: Showing great care and steady effort in one's work.
example_en: Assiduous note-taking got her through the dense lecture series.
example_uz: Tirishqoqlik bilan qayd olish uni og'ir ma'ruzalar seriyasidan olib o'tdi.

definition_en: Hostile and ready to fight or argue.
example_en: He turned belligerent the moment the referee's call went against him.
example_uz: Hakam qarori unga qarshi chiqishi bilanoq u tajovuzkor tus oldi.

definition_en: A harsh mixture of loud, unpleasant sounds.
example_en: The market at dawn was a cacophony of shouting vendors.
example_uz: Tongdagi bozor baqirayotgan sotuvchilarning g'ala-g'ovuriga to'la edi.

definition_en: Holding on firmly and refusing to give up.
example_en: Her tenacious research finally uncovered the original letter.
example_uz: Uning qat'iyatli tadqiqoti nihoyat asl xatni topdi.
